descriptions.arrival_delivery: Newly authored medical handoff before Fei's four-day recovery (retail field 213). The attendant asks about unconsciousness and transport, checks breathing, and accepts care; the escort passes on custody instructions. Fei remains silent. Do not invent the circumstances of his capture or give this scene knowledge of later revelations.
descriptions.baptism_exchange: Anthology route abbreviates preliminary bouts. Stage Rico coercing and striking the reluctant Fei; this is not a friendly spar. Dialogue is newly authored.
descriptions.baptism_after: Chosen anthology route: Fei reaches Rico, loses, and receives Rank A. Retain the chosen retail-route visual behavior if available; do not present this as Rico kindly training him.
descriptions.defense_before: One short playable Stier defense. This new anthology bout establishes reputation; it is not a recovered historical match.
descriptions.dblock_worker_missing: Replace the earlier worker interaction as the disappearances become known.
descriptions.investigation_request: Requires the earlier explosion against Fei to be established. Rico admits his men sabotaged Weltall, apologizes, and still suspects Fei.
descriptions.sewer_key: Compact-route adaptation: stage the passkey visibly under a grating on the waterfall walkway. Do not claim this is the full retail key puzzle.
descriptions.sewer_drain: At the selected drain, after the player has found the bell and consulted Gramps. Fei repeats the advice so all speakers belong to the sewer party.
descriptions.redrum_after: Rico and Fei accept the investigation as finished. The narration and Citan do not declare Redrum the murderer. Its identity, family, and origins remain unknown to Rico.
descriptions.bandage: New gesture of reluctant trust. Show Hammer finishing the bandage during the silent beat.
descriptions.finals_exchange: Dedicated staged Fei victory. Do not ask the player to win a concealed forced-loss battle or establish an exact five-round outcome.
descriptions.crash_before: Limited incident staging preserves the later account of an assassination attempt disguised as an accident. Never add private dialogue establishing innocent failed controls.
descriptions.crash_public: The loss-of-control statement is an incomplete public account. No omniscient confirmation and no invented sabotage device.
descriptions.chapter_end: Stop before the locked door, DNA response, familiar smell, childhood recall, or parentage discovery. Chapter 3 owns those events.
descriptions.fei_explosion_report: After the Stier defense and before the missing-person reports. Covers Fei's intervening sabotaged bout without an invented cockpit scene; Rico seeks his subordinates.
descriptions.treatment_gate_locked: Three independent objective hints: block 0 for missing key, block 1 for unexamined slime, block 2 for missing bell. Prefer selecting the first applicable hint rather than replaying all three after some objectives are complete.
descriptions.fei_before_investigation: Fei/Citan fallback after the Baptism but before the investigation agreement. Do not show before Fei has been through the Baptism.
descriptions.fei_after_investigation: Fei/Citan fallback after the agreement and before the sewer fight; no Hammer lines or repeated confession.
descriptions.sewer_after_redrum: Short repeat response for the closed sewer route after the Redrum encounter; does not replay discovery of the wound.
